description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractGlobalJsonParsableRegistry' responsible for collecting and managing JSON parsable strategies for subclasses of a given type, based on annotations. It uses class indexing to find annotated classes and creates parsing strategies accordingly.

classes.name: AbstractGlobalJsonParsableRegistry
classes.description: An abstract class that manages JSON parsing strategies for subclasses of a specified type, based on annotations.

methods.name: mergeParsingStrategies
methods.description: Merges two maps of JSON parsing strategies, with the second overriding the first in case of key conflicts.

methods.name: initAnnotationBasedParseStrategies
methods.description: Initializes parsing strategies by scanning classes annotated with a specific annotation, filtering by assignability, and creating strategies via a factory.
